sections.text: Equipment:
Gas Recirculation Fan

Centrifugal
 Radial Flow

RI6/182/5A/CA/ILD/3G
 DE, CARDENAS

Procedure:
 Equipment Inspection 
 (I1-M1)
Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be
performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.

The function of the GRF is 
to
maintain the reheated steam temperature at 
the rated value over the whole control range in order to allow the NOX
reduction.

Technical Specifications of 
Fan:

The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general 
 director eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, approved by eng. Mohamed 
 El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh 
Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. 
Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS 
coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Wear safety helmet, shoes,
belt, gloves etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of the
fan motor

Disconnect electric terminals of
fan motor

The fan must be isolated
mechanically by closing delivery damper

items:
Work order must be issued and the
 qualified maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety helmet, shoes,
belt, gloves etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of the
fan motor

Disconnect electric terminals of
fan motor

The fan must be isolated
mechanically by closing delivery damper

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items:
Complete maintenance tools
 set

Cleaning fluid manual
 puller
Dial indicator

Vibrometer
 straight edge

Oil: DTE 27 
 Grease: Mobilplex

sections.text:
Work
to be Carried Out

Check bearing temp. max
= 85C, so change the oil or inspect the bearing then repair or change

Check for abnormal noise define the cause of this 
noise if it is from the bearing or the motor or the internal parts (Repair or 
change)

Check bearing vibration (Max 4.8 mm/s) after 
repairing the cause of vibration make balance or alignment

Check oil levels lubricate over 
running

Check shaft alignment if there are any abnormal 
reading make a new alignment

Check fan flexible connections and joints for damage 
and repair or change the defected parts
Check coupling clearance 6-8 mm
Check inboard and outboard bearing clearance
Change the oil and regrease
